title: wiki list on a missing project/wiki/ is silent (no init hint)
description: Researcher 0.20.1 AT on /workspace/research-pod. kbs wiki render on a missing project/wiki/ prints a create hint (kbs wiki init). kbs wiki list on the same project prints nothing and exits 0. Product rule: list should name the missing wiki and say how to create it, same as render. Do not look like an empty wiki that exists. Empty-string search listing all pages is specified (Wiki search with empty query lists all pages). Do not change that to 0 results.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Papyrus 0.20.1 AT: kbs wiki search foo with no project/wiki/ prints 0 results and exits 0, no init hint. Spec already says no matches when the wiki dir is missing; keep that, but add the same create hint as render. Do not change empty-string search (match-all).
